reason: The PR primarily changes `pkg/store/copr/*`, specifically coprocessor range handling and region-cache interaction. Ensuring key-range monotonicity is a core correctness invariant for coprocessor request splitting/routing; mistakes here can cause missing rows, duplicated rows, wrong region dispatch, or other storage-layer scan correctness issues across many queries. Despite the small file count, this is a central runtime path rather than a local fix, so it merits a blocker/high-severity deep review.
